d_gate.rule: Run D only if, at the frozen C1 and C2 constants, C1's equal-cell mean held-out NLL over validation cells with SNR <= 30 dB is lower than C2's (= no filter there) by more than 1e-12. Otherwise record D as skipped: above 20 dB u_k equals the noise scale / sqrt(2) to within 0.3%, so D adds nothing where the filter acts.
d_gate.reason: C1 did not beat C2 (no filter) below 30 dB on validation held-out loss; above 20 dB u_k equals the noise scale / sqrt(2) to within 0.3%, so D adds nothing where the filter acts.
